summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing an investor presentation for its first quarter 2026 results. The filing is a routine earnings-related disclosure by a foreign private issuer, providing forward-looking statements and non-GAAP financial measures. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is announced or discussed. The filing is an ordinary periodic update with no transactional or transformative component.
